verdict.rationale: The product is itself a public API with extensive first-party documentation: an API reference for the Sonar POST endpoint, Agent/Search/Orchestrator APIs with OpenAI-compatible endpoints, quickstart API key generation, official typed SDKs, and pay-as-you-go access. Hands-on probes independently confirm a live OpenAPI spec and llms.txt, and the GitHub SDK repo corroborates usable client code.
